thread:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout of api.v2 to 5% traffic in us-west-2. canary window 15m. notify @oncall if any 5xx spike.

sophi: pinging — watching telemetry dashboards. :eyes:

ian: seeing small uptick in 4xx from mobile-sdk on v2 requests, mostly 400 and JSON parse errors. sample: 
```json
{
  "path": "/v2/generate",
  "status": 400,
  "error": "invalid header: X-Client-Version"
}
```

maria: huh. mobile SDK normalizes header keys lower-case. our gateway expects `X-Client-Version` exact case in v2 header negotiation. that would break older SDKs.

kevin: timeline? did we change header matching semantics in v2 rollout?

sophi: yes, v2 introduced stricter header gating to route legacy clients to v1. we forgot to accept case-folded keys.

ian: impact: ~0.8% of canary traffic, concentrated on android sdk < 1.4.2. affected tenants show high error rate.

maria: can we patch gateway quickly to accept case-insensitive header match?

kevin: hotfix would be small — normalize headers before matching. dev + test -> ~20m deploy. but that still means canary traffic sees errors until patch is live.

sophi: recommended immediate action: PAUSE rollout, pin route so existing clients keep hitting v1, open rollback if pin insufficient.

deploy-bot: deploybot: pausing rollout (canary_id=api_v2_canary_70678). traffic split rolled back to previous state.

ian: confirming: canary paused. telemetry sliding back to baseline. good.

maria: i'll cut a quick gateway patch branch and run unit tests. I'll also add a small casefolding unit to avoid regressions.

kevin: if patch passes, plan: 1) hotpatch gateway in us-west-2 2) run smoke tests 3) re-run small canary (1%) with mobile flagged traffic 4) increase if clean. if patch fails, we keep v2 paused and prepare release notes update + client rollback advisory.

sophi: ops checklist: assign operator for the rollout reattempt, schedule 10m quiet window, update release-notes with compatibility note. cc: @customersuccess to prep messaging.

maria: patch deployed to staging, tests green. will promote to canary if we get sign-off. build: `gateway@patch/header-casefold`

kevin: thumbs on my end after one smoke run. request @sophi to approve canary retry.

sophi: approved. re-enabling canary at 1% but with mobile-sdk flag excluded for 30m. monitor logs for 400 regressions. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploybot: resuming canary (canary_id=api_v2_canary_70678_retry), target 1% traffic, excluded_tag=mobile-sdk-old. expected ramp 10m.

ian: initial telemetry looks clean. no 400 spike in first 3m. continuing to watch.

maria: pushing monitoring alert for error ratio >0.5% for 10m. also adding a temporary regression eval set on short prompts used by mobile clients.

kevin: if green at 30m, we can widen to 5% and unexclude mobile after another check. note: update release-notes to call out header case insensitivity change and advise clients to upgrade to SDK 1.4.2+ or rely on header normalization.

sophi: action items summary: [maria] hotpatch branch + prod deploy (done), [ian] telemetry query & smoke, [kevin] release-notes edit and canary runbook update, [maria] add unit test. CS notified.

maria: creating a short patch changelog for the release notes: "Gateway: tolerate case-insensitive X-Client-Version header to preserve compatibility with older SDKs; no behavioral change intended."

deploy-bot: reminder: will auto-rollback if 5xx or 4xx error_rate >1% sustained for 5m.

ian: last check at +48m: metrics stable, expanding to 5% now.

kevin: after 2h with no regressions, schedule full rollout over next maintenance window. I'll shepherd release notes and client comms.

sophi: closing thread for runbook — will leave notes in the deploy ticket and add postmortem blurb about missing header contract in preflight checks. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks everyone.
